    People also ask
    Is TBS on Paramount or Peacock?
    No, TBS is not available on Peacock, neither live nor on-demand. TBS is owned by Warner Bros. Discovery, while Peacock is NBCUniversal's streaming service, and channels are typically exclusive to their parent company's platforms or licensed to live TV streaming services.
